visual_action: A static, close-up shot of President Joe Biden speaking directly to the camera. He is in a room with bookshelves in the background.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is shown speaking for the entire duration of the video.

on_screen_text.text: President Biden on Student Loan Forgiveness 🎓

spoken_summary: Joe Biden defends his student loan forgiveness policy, stating, "I will never apologize for helping working Americans and middle-class" families. He contrasts this with a "two trillion dollar tax cut that mainly benefited the wealthiest Americans and the biggest corporations" which he claims was not paid for and increased the deficit. Biden then compares student loan forgiveness to the forgiveness of over $700 billion in PPP loans for small businesses during the pandemic, arguing that no one complained about those loans causing inflation and that they were the right thing to do.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Joe Biden's spoken remarks. There is no music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot with no cuts or edits.
central_claim: Student loan forgiveness is a just policy to help the middle class, and criticism of it is hypocritical given past support for massive tax cuts for the wealthy and business loan forgiveness.
intended_effect: To persuade the viewer that President Biden's student loan forgiveness policy is fair and to view its critics as hypocrites who favor the wealthy over the middle class.
